basic_info.description: This expansive Inner Mission home offers five bedrooms and three full baths, plus a legal one-bed/one-bath unit with a separate entrance. At the heart of the home is an open chef's kitchen, family room, and dining area designed for everyday comfort and effortless entertaining. Large french doors lead directly to a private outdoor haven featuring multiple decks and a turfed backyard. Upstairs, the generous en-suite primary suite sits quietly at the rear and opens to its own secluded deck, while two additional bedrooms share a convenient Jack-and-Jill bath. The main living level also includes two versatile bedrooms, a second living room, and a full bath, offering excellent flexibility for guests or a home office. With its own entrance, the lower level provides a fully independent one-bedroom unit, ideal for extended family, guests, or rental income. A two-car, side-by-side garage adds abundant storage and easy city living.
